job.title: Manager/Architect - SailPoint IdentityNow
job.description:
Manager/Architect - SailPoint IdentityNow, IGA - Edinburgh - 12 months (3 days on-site)
Primary Skills: SailPoint IdentityNow, IGA, Transformations, API, Rule (Connector/Cloud), Access Certification, Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).environment.
Secondary Skills: IAM Architecture, SSO, MFA, Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Compliance & Audit, API Integrations, App onboarding and Risk & Governance.

Responsibilities include:
Lead Identity Governance and Administration initiatives across Asset & Wealth Management platforms.
Drive onboarding and governance of applications, directories, cloud platforms, and business-critical systems into SailPoint ISC.
Define and implement access governance processes including access requests, approvals, Transformations, Identity rules, connector rules,certifications, segregation of duties (SoD), and privileged access controls.
Collaborate with business, security, compliance, and technology teams to ensure secure access to sensitive client and financial data.
Design and optimize identity life cycle workflows including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver processes.
Establish role management, access models, entitlement governance, and policy-based controls.
Lead remediation activities related to audit findings, compliance gaps, and identity-related risks.
Provide governance oversight for identity integrations, connectors, provisioning workflows, and access certification campaigns.
Support regulatory compliance requirements including SOX, SEC, FINRA, GDPR, and internal security policies.
Drive operational excellence through process improvements, automation, reporting, search queries and service maturity initiatives.
Mentor technical teams and provide guidance on SailPoint best practices, architecture, and implementation standards.
Partner with stakeholders to define IAM roadmaps, governance standards, and strategic identity initiatives.
Support production operations, incident management, troubleshooting, and continuous service improvement efforts.

Expected Deliverables
IdentityNow Governance & implementation Framework.
Identity Lifecycle Management (JML) Process Documentation.
Application Onboarding and Access Governance Standards.
Access Certification, Role Management, and SoD Governance Framework.
IAM Policies, Procedures, and Compliance Documentation.
Identity Integration Architecture and Connector Design Documentation.
Audit Remediation Plans and Compliance Support Artifacts.
Access Governance Dashboards and Executive Reporting Metrics.
Identity Risk Assessment and Mitigation Recommendations.
Operational Runbooks, Knowledge Transfer Materials, and Support Documentation.
IAM Roadmap and Continuous Improvement Recommendations.
Production Support, Service Maturity, and Operational Governance

job.title: Principal Cloud Engineer / Architect
job.description:
Principal Cloud Engineer - Slough (2 days and remote)- 6 months
Must-Have
Significant experience designing and implementing cloud architectures.
Proven expertise in designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure cloud platforms.
Strong understanding of modern cloud architecture and distributed systems.
Strong networking and Infrastructure as Code experience.
Experience designing secure, highly available and resilient systems.
Strong understanding of cloud security and identity.
Experience with containers and Kubernetes or comparable technologies.
Experience with APIs, integration, messaging and event-driven architectures.
Experience influencing cloud or technology strategy at senior level.
Strong architectural judgement and ability to explain technical trade-offs.
Experience working closely with engineers and Solution Designers to turn architecture into working solutions.
Ability to work independently and create clarity from ambiguity.
Strong communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to navigate complex stakeholder environments and engage effectively with senior architects, engineering leaders and security stakeholders.

Role
Cloud Strategy & Architecture Help define our overall cloud strategy and target architecture. Work with our Architecture community to establish and roll out practical architectural principles and standards. Define the foundations required to support scalable, secure and resilient workloads. Create a pragmatic roadmap from initial cloud foundation through to production. Make architectural decisions based on business and technical requirements. Work with technology leadership, architects, Solution Designers and engineering teams to align on the approach. Build the Cloud Foundation Cloud account/subscription and landing-zone architecture. Identity and access management. Network architecture and connectivity. Security and governance foundations. Infrastructure as Code and automation. CI/CD and deployment patterns. Observability, logging and monitoring. Secrets and key management. Resilience, backup and disaster recovery. The aim is to create a secure, scalable and well-automated cloud foundation that engineering teams can build on. From Architecture to Reality Work directly with engineers to build the initial platform. Create reference architectures and reusable patterns. Develop prototypes and proof-of-concepts where useful. Review and challenge technical designs. Help establish engineering standards and patterns. Get involved in complex technical problems when required. Page 1 You should be comfortable moving between high-level architecture discussions and detailed conversations around networking, IAM, Kubernetes, APIs, distributed systems, Infrastructure as Code and cloud services.

job.title: AWS Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Senior AWS DevOps Engineer - 6 months - London/hybrid - £475 - 500 - urgent (needs to start within 2 weeks max.)
Required Technical Skills
  • Strong hands-on experience with core AWS services such as EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, Route 53, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch and CloudTrail.
  • Advanced experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation and/or Terraform.
  • Strong CI/CD expertise with Jenkins or comparable pipeline platforms, including automated quality gates and deployment controls.
  • Proficiency in Scripting and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell or a similar language.
  • Practical experience with Git-based source control, branching strategies and collaborative code-review practices.
  • Experience with Linux administration and working knowledge of Windows-based cloud workloads.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes-based platforms such as Amazon EKS, or AWS-native container services such as ECS.
  • Good understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and secure configuration.
  • Experience implementing monitoring, logging, alerting and incident-response capabilities for cloud platforms.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation and stakeholder-management skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Personally design, provision, configure and maintain highly available, scalable and secure AWS environments; validate implementations against enterprise standards and AWS Well-Architected principles.
  • Write, test, review and maintain reusable infrastructure-as-code modules using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation, including state management, versioning and automated validation.
  • Build, enhance and support CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, AWS CodePipeline or equivalent.
  • Automate application build, test, deployment, configuration and release processes across multiple environments.
  • Design and operate containerised platforms using Docker, Amazon ECS and/or Amazon EKS, including deployment patterns, scaling and platform upgrades.
  • Implement AWS networking and security controls, including VPCs, subnets, routing, security groups, IAM roles and policies, encryption, secrets management and multi-account governance.
  • Establish monitoring, logging, alerting and observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail and suitable enterprise tooling.
  • Improve platform reliability through capacity planning, backup, disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability remediation and operational readiness practices.
  • Support application and infrastructure migration from on-premises or hybrid environments to AWS, including assessment, landing-zone preparation, cutover and post-migration optimisation.
  • Independently investigate complex infrastructure, deployment, performance, security and availability issues by analysing logs, metrics, configurations and code; complete root-cause analysis, implement the fix and drive preventive actions through to closure.
  • Partner with developers, architects, security teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into practical cloud solutions.
  • Create and maintain high-level designs, detailed technical documentation, runbooks, standards and migration records.
  • Provide technical guidance, code and design reviews, mentoring and continuous-improvement leadership across the engineering team.
  • Evaluate platform usage and cost, recommend right-sizing and optimisation opportunities, and support effective cloud governance.
Preferred Skills and Qualifications
  • Experience designing hybrid-cloud solutions and integrating AWS with on-premises data centres.
  • Knowledge of configuration-management tools such as Ansible, Chef or Puppet.
  • Experience with microservices, platform engineering, PaaS environments and service integration.
  • Understanding of SRE practices, service-level objectives, error budgets and resilience engineering.
  • Experience supporting cloud assessments, architecture reviews, audits, RFP responses or pre-sales solutioning.
  • AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional.
  • Exposure to other cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud is advantageous.
